remediationItems.name: shared-response-paired-comparison
remediationItems.requirement: Capture one provider response per case/run, then branch the immutable response through control and candidate post-processing without a second provider call.

remediationItems.name: versioned-slice-thresholds
remediationItems.requirement: Bind slice labels, denominators, thresholds, zero-denominator policy and macro/micro statistic before the next experiment.

remediationItems.name: trigger-quote-contract
remediationItems.requirement: Decide which predicates require trigger_quote, encode it in schema/materializer/scorer, and test missing-trigger fail-closed behavior.

remediationItems.name: execution-package-freeze
remediationItems.requirement: Commit runner, evaluator, materializer, prompt/configuration, preregistration revision and tests together; authorization must bind that commit and every digest.

remediationItems.name: new-stage-a-preregistration
remediationItems.requirement: Only after RM-01 through RM-04 pass, publish a new experiment preregistration and authorization packet; no provider execution is implied by this track.

fixedConstraints: Do not inspect validation or held-out data.
Do not change gold, ontology or immutable f09 evidence.
Do not mark S12-R24 or G6 complete.
Do not call a provider before a new authorization is issued.
